poll_interval.label: Poll interval
poll_interval.description: Seconds between checks of the bubblemail daemon.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_empty.description: Remove the bar widget when there is no unread mail and no account errors.

max_mails.label: Mails in panel
max_mails.description: Maximum number of pending mails listed in the panel.

show_mail_client.label: Mail client button
show_mail_client.description: Show a button in the panel that opens your mail client.

mail_client_command.label: Mail client command
mail_client_command.description: Command that button runs. Leave empty to use the desktop's default mail application.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Send a desktop notification when new mail arrives and when an account enters an error state.
